title: House Democrats Demand AI Safety Incident Reports Within 48 Hours

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock
Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Three committee heads in the House have asked developers of artificial intelligence to notify the government rapidly whenever a safety flaw is detected in their models. The request seeks to compel firms such as Google and Meta to report newly discovered safety incidents within 48 hours, though the reporting window drops to 24 hours if the event may impact critical infrastructure.

The lawmakers also demanded that OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceXSI and other major players provide a full accounting of all known past safety failures by Nov. 11. House Democrats indicated that the push for strict disclosure timelines provides a preview of their oversight priorities should they regain the House majority.
